description: Discover WeRoad's adventures for small-group (8-15 travelers), with people your age, led by a group leader. Designed for solo travelers who want to explore the world with like-minded people. Search itineraries by destination, dates, and travel mood, see full day-by-day plans, and find the right group trip across Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas, Oceania, and the Middle East.
